scenes.narration: 在这里写第一句系统旁白，交代故事背景与主人公。
code: // 先读 recipe.md：正式制作时在工程 figures/ 中重新定妆，不沿用示例人物。
const T = api.t; const S = TT.shadow;
const CAST = S.cast(api.data('cast'), { official: api.data('official'), soldier: api.data('soldier'), crone: api.data('crone') });
const cue = api.cues[0]; const at = (dt = 0) => cue.start + dt;
TT.board.stage(ctx, { W, H }, { seed: 3, variant: 0, screen: 'white' });
const L = S.light(ctx, W, H, { t: T, base: 1, variant: 0 });
S.prop(ctx, api.data('reeds'), { t: T, x: W * 0.90, y: H * 0.8, size: 280, at: 0.5, depth: 0.4 });
S.title(ctx, { t: T, text: '未命名皮影戏', at: at(0.2), until: cue.end + 0.4, x: W * 0.36, y: H * 0.36, size: 104 });
const pose = S.motion(T, [S.steps.walk(at(0.5), W * 0.70, 1.6), S.steps.talk(at(1.8), 1.8)], { x: -300, face: 1, size: 560, seed: 1 });
const actor = S.puppet(ctx, CAST.刘邦, pose, { t: T, at: at(0.5), y: H * 0.8, size: 560, enter: 'left' });
S.placard(ctx, { t: T, text: '主人公', at: at(1.4), until: api.d, over: actor, size: 54 });
S.dim(ctx, W, H, L.dark);
S.systemCaption(ctx, api.cues.find((c) => T >= c.start && T < c.end), { t: T, W, H });
TT.board.stageFrame(ctx, { W, H });

scenes.narration: 前有大蛇当道，还是绕道吧。
code: // 角色对白只写讲话内容；角色名交给固定 dialogueCaption。
const T = api.t; const S = TT.shadow;
const CAST = S.cast(api.data('cast'), { official: api.data('official'), soldier: api.data('soldier'), crone: api.data('crone') });
const cue = api.cues[0]; const at = (dt = 0) => cue.start + dt;
const lamps = [{ at: 0, to: 0.85, dur: 0.01, color: 'cold' }];
TT.board.stage(ctx, { W, H }, { seed: 3, variant: 0, screen: 'white' });
const L = S.light(ctx, W, H, { t: T, lamps, base: 1, variant: 0 });
const pose = S.motion(T, [S.steps.talk(at(0.2), 1.8), S.steps.bow(at(1.0))], { x: W * 0.46, face: 1, size: 500, seed: 2 });
S.puppet(ctx, CAST.探路人, pose, { t: T, at: 0.3, y: H * 0.8, size: 500, enter: 'fade' });
S.snake(ctx, { t: T, x: W * 0.82, y: H * 0.8 - 50, len: 520, w: 52, face: 'left', at: at(0.4), rear: [at(1.0), at(1.8)], rearH: 170 });
S.placard(ctx, { t: T, text: '前有大蛇当径，愿还', at: at(0.4), until: cue.end + 0.2, y: H * 0.16, size: 54, color: 'black', swing: false });
S.dim(ctx, W, H, L.dark);
S.dialogueCaption(ctx, api.cues.find((c) => T >= c.start && T < c.end), '探路人', { t: T, W, H });
TT.board.stageFrame(ctx, { W, H });
